mathematical_meanings: Left image: The symbol "A" names a specific geometric point at the indicated location. Right image: The symbol "A" names the set represented by the indicated circle.
Rationales: The left occurrence is A at the upper-left endpoint of diagonal AE. The right occurrence is A below the red circle with 6, 9, 14, 16 and 18 on its left-only side. The left placement shows that the symbol names a specific geometric point at the indicated location, while the right placement shows that it names the set represented by the indicated circle.
